summary.en: Kidney disease, rare endocrine disorders and cell therapy broaden a business still dominated by cystic fibrosis. Povetacicept is under regulatory review, while multiple other programs remain in pivotal or proof-of-concept development.
summary.zh: 肾病、罕见内分泌疾病和细胞疗法拓宽了仍以囊性纤维化为主导的业务。Povetacicept正在接受监管审评,其他多个项目仍处于关键性或概念验证开发阶段。

ind.en: IgA nephropathy; also membranous nephropathy and myasthenia gravis
ind.zh: IgA肾病;另有膜性肾病和重症肌无力

ind.en: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia; also ACTH-dependent Cushing’s syndrome
ind.zh: 先天性肾上腺皮质增生症;另有ACTH依赖性库欣综合征

target.zh: 产胰岛素胰岛细胞替代

ind.zh: 伴严重低血糖的1型糖尿病
疼痛性糖尿病周围神经病变

next.en: Phase 2 enrollment complete by year-end 2026; results mid-2027
next.zh: II期入组于2026年底前完成;结果于2027年中期公布

ind.zh: 常染色体显性多囊肾病

target.zh: 产胰岛素胰岛细胞替代

ind.en: Type 1 diabetes, regardless of blood type

watch.en: Q3 CF revenue was $3.27bn of $3.44bn total revenue.
watch.zh: 第三季度CF收入为32.7亿美元,总收入为34.4亿美元。

watch.en: Povetacicept has a November 30 FDA date; inaxaplin interim data are expected early 2027.
watch.zh: Povetacicept的FDA日期为11月30日;inaxaplin中期数据预计于2027年初公布。

watch.en: Crinetics acquisition closed September 1; Vertex borrowed $4.5bn in Q3.
watch.zh: Crinetics收购于9月1日完成;Vertex在第三季度借款45亿美元。

watch.en: Vertex prioritizes VX-017 over zimislecel to reach patients regardless of blood type.
watch.zh: Vertex优先推进VX-017而非zimislecel,以便无论血型均可惠及患者。

gaps: No complete published phase counts were verified; counts is null.
Phase 1/2 VX-017 and VX-670 map to 2; zimislecel Phase 1/2/3 maps to 3. Combined study labels do not establish the phase of every cohort.
Povetacicept’s priority-review filing supersedes the Phase 3 label on the general pipeline page.
No next milestone was verified for zimislecel; next is null. VX-407 2027 results timing is from the Q3 presentation. Early-2027 inaxaplin guidance maps to 2027H1.
Suzetrigine’s unfiled Phase 3 neuropathic-pain expansion and same-indication geographic/pediatric expansions of approved products are excluded under the brief’s approved-asset rule.

Origins remain unverified for zimislecel, VX-993, VX-407 and VX-017. Historical 2024 acquisition/license sources and the 2025 VX-993 mechanism source predate June 2026; current stages and guidance use the November 2026 pipeline/results.

Povetacicept is an engineered fusion protein mapped to other. VX-670 is an oligonucleotide-peptide conjugate mapped to other; the previous target text described modality rather than a molecular target, so target is null.
